description: This file sets up and runs a WebRTC-based chatbot using Pipecat framework. It defines behavior for handling LLM interactions, WebRTC events, and pipeline configuration for a text-only conversational bot.

classes.name: RTVIProcessor
classes.description: Core processing class managing WebRTC interactions, actions, and event handling in the chatbot pipeline.

classes.name: RTVIAction
classes.description: Represents an action that can be executed within the RTVI framework, including its service, name, arguments, and handler.

classes.name: RTVIActionArgument
classes.description: Defines an argument for an RTVI action, specifying name and type.

classes.name: RTVIServerMessageFrame
classes.description: Frame class used to send server messages to the WebRTC client.

classes.name: Pipeline
classes.description: Represents a sequence of processing steps for the chatbot, combining input, actions, and output.

classes.name: PipelineTask
classes.description: Encapsulates a pipeline with parameters, metrics, and observers, to be executed as a unit.

classes.name: PipelineParams
classes.description: Parameters configuring a pipeline's execution, like metrics and timeout.

classes.name: PipelineRunner
classes.description: Manages running the processing pipeline, handling signals and lifecycle.

classes.name: LLMContext
classes.description: Stores the current conversation context for the language model.

classes.name: LLMContextAggregatorPair
classes.description: Handles the aggregation of context and responses for the LLM, bridging between context state and the processing pipeline.

methods.name: create_action_llm_append_to_messages(context_aggregator: OpenAIContextAggregatorPair)
methods.description: Creates an RTVI action to append messages to the conversation and optionally interrupt the bot.

methods.name: run_bot(transport: BaseTransport, runner_args: RunnerArguments)
methods.description: Initializes services, builds the pipeline, and manages WebRTC events to run the chatbot.

methods.name: bot(runner_args: RunnerArguments)
methods.description: Main entry point for the chatbot, establishing transport and invoking run_bot.

methods.name: ActionResult action_llm_append_to_messages_handler( rtvi: RTVIProcessor, service: str, arguments: dict[str, any] )

ctags.name: action_llm_append_to_messages_handler
ctags.signature: ( rtvi: RTVIProcessor, service: str, arguments: dict[str, any] )
